scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:evals
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:snapshots && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 -r --if-present test:unit && pnpm run test:engineering
scripts.test:snapshots: pnpm snapshots replay --case runtime/minimal-completion && pnpm snapshots replay --case runtime/recovery && pnpm snapshots replay --case runtime/cancel && pnpm snapshots replay --case memory/memory-recall && pnpm snapshots replay --case runtime/subagent
scripts.test:engineering: node --test scripts/build-brand-icons.test.mjs scripts/build-native-computer.test.mjs scripts/build-desktop-product.test.mjs scripts/preview-site.test.mjs scripts/site-projection.test.mjs scripts/create-preview-release.test.mjs scripts/clean-dist.test.mjs scripts/verify-lockfile.test.mjs scripts/verify-release.test.mjs scripts/verify-v2-docs.test.mjs scripts/gen-current-baseline.test.mjs scripts/verify-translation-pairs.test.mjs scripts/gen-reference-catalogs.test.mjs scripts/verify-boundaries.test.mjs scripts/gen-module-graph.test.mjs scripts/verify-invariants.test.mjs benchmarks/support/runner.test.mjs && vitest run scripts/check-coverage.test.ts
scripts.coverage: pnpm run build && vitest run --config vitest.coverage.config.ts && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs
scripts.evals: pnpm run build && vitest run --config vitest.evals.config.ts
